The plate looks like a square plate of roughly 22 cm per side, so I'm treating it as a side-to-dinner size.

- **Scrambled eggs:** They cover about 25% of the plate, roughly 10 x 11 cm, and are about 3 cm high. That gives about 150 g.
- **Roasted sweet potato and potato cubes:** They cover about 18% of the plate and are about 2.5 cm high. That gives about 110 g. A few darker cubes may be sausage or potato, but I'm counting them all as sweet potato with a little oil.
